entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wei Shou (506–572), courtesy name Boqi (伯起), was a Chinese author born in Quyang County in Julu Commandery who served under the Northern Qi dynasty. He wrote the Book of Wei, composed in 554, an important Chinese historical text.
